Avatar.name: Avatar
Avatar.summary: Circular (associate) or rounded-square (entity) image with an initials/icon fallback (Radix Avatar).

props.name: variant
props.description: associate = person (circle); entity = organization (rounded square).

parts.description: Initials text or an icon; shown when the image is missing, errored or loading.

children.note: Initials text or an icon sized via var(--avatar-icon-size).

constraints.rule: Avatar.Image and Avatar.Fallback are only valid inside Avatar.Root.
Pass alt on Avatar.Image; a decorative Avatar needs alt="".

notSupported: sizes other than xs | sm | md | lg | xl | 2xl (no numeric px size).
variant values other than associate | entity.
a single-component form (<Avatar src=...>); compose Root + Image + Fallback.

Box.name: Box
Box.summary: Padding-only layout primitive (div) with token-backed padding steps.

props.name: padding
props.description: Density-reactive spacing step.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child element instead of the default element (Radix Slot).

constraints.rule: Padding is the named steps only; no numbers or px strings.

Button.name: Button
Button.summary: Triggers an action (submit, open/close something). Navigation to another place is a Link, not a Button.

parts.description: Convenience wrapper composing Root + optional Icon(s) + Label. Use this by default.

props.name: children
props.description: Label content. Stays mounted (as the accessible name) when showLabel is false.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: false = icon-only button; label is visually hidden.

props.name: iconStart
props.description: Icon before the label.

props.name: iconEnd
props.description: Icon after the label.

props.name: destructive
props.description: Critical-response styling; combines with every variant.

props.name: density
props.description: Sets data-density on the element; omit to inherit from the nearest ancestor.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child element instead of a <button> (Radix Slot).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Overrides the accessible name.

passthrough.note: All native button attributes and event handlers.

parts.description: Bare styled button for custom composition. Use only when Button's iconStart/iconEnd/label layout is not enough.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Square, icon-only sizing. Button sets this from showLabel={false}; set it yourself only on Root.

props.name: visuallyHidden
props.description: Hides the label visually but keeps it as the accessible name.

constraints.rule: An icon-only button (showLabel={false}) must still have children (its accessible name) or an aria-label.
Button.Icon and Button.Label are only valid inside Button.Root.
If the element navigates (same page anchor or another page), use Link instead of Button.
Use destructive (not a custom color) for delete-like actions; do not use variant='primary' non-destructive for irreversible actions.
At most three buttons per group; order tertiary, secondary, primary left to right.

notSupported: size prop (Figma has no Size variant; size comes from density).
variant values other than primary | secondary | tertiary (no 'reversed', 'ghost', 'link', 'outline', 'danger').
href prop (use Link, or asChild with an anchor).

Card.name: Card
Card.summary: Bordered surface with optional collapsible header (Radix Collapsible); compose Root + Header + Body + Footer.

parts.description: defaultOpen is true. open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange/disabled only matter when Header is expandable.

props.name: density
props.description: Sets data-density on the element; omit to inherit from the nearest ancestor.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child element (e.g. <section>) instead of a <div>.

passthrough.from: ComponentProps<'div'> + Radix Collapsible.Root (open, defaultOpen, onOpenChange, disabled)

props.name: expandable
props.description: Header becomes the Collapsible trigger and renders as a <button>.

props.name: showBorder
props.description: Bottom border; on an expandable header it only shows while open.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref<HTMLElement> (the element is a div or a button).

children.note: When expandable, children render inside a native <button>: no nested links, buttons or form controls.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon.

parts.description: Collapses with an expandable Header.
Column layout; collapses with an expandable Header.

constraints.rule: Card.* parts are only valid inside Card.Root.
Do not nest interactive elements inside an expandable Card.Header.
Card.Footer is a column; for a row of buttons use Dialog.Footer-style layout yourself.

notSupported: controlled collapse without Card.Header expandable (open only has an effect on collapsible content).

Checkbox.name: Checkbox

passthrough.note: checked accepts boolean | "indeterminate"; also defaultChecked, onCheckedChange, required, disabled, name, value.

constraints.rule: Indeterminate state is checked="indeterminate"; there is no separate prop.
Do not wrap in your own <label> or add htmlFor; the row is already a label.

Dialog.name: Dialog
Dialog.summary: Modal dialog (Radix Dialog) with built-in scrim, close button, title and optional description.

parts.renders: Radix Dialog.Content in a Portal, plus Scrim and CloseButton
parts.description: Portal-rendered; sets data-density itself because portals escape the ancestor cascade.

props.name: title
props.description: Always rendered; the dialog's accessible name.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional; omit and Radix warns about a missing description.

props.name: closeButtonClassName
props.description: Merged onto the built-in close button.

props.name: visuallyHideTitle
props.description: Keeps the title for a11y but hides it visually.

props.name: scrimClassName
props.description: Merged onto the backdrop Scrim.

passthrough.note: Includes onOpenAutoFocus (default focuses the close button), onEscapeKeyDown, onPointerDownOutside, onInteractOutside, forceMount, asChild.

parts.description: Row layout for action buttons; renders its own Separator above itself.

passthrough.note: Supports asChild; use it to wrap Cancel-style buttons.

constraints.rule: Content always needs a title; use visuallyHideTitle to hide it visually rather than omitting it.
Content and Trigger must be inside Dialog.Root.
Do not add a Separator above Footer; it renders its own.
Do not wrap Content in a scroll container; it is its own scroll container (wrapping breaks Radix scroll-lock).
Do not add your own close button; Content has one built in.

notSupported: size / width props (max width comes from the component token).
placement / position props (always top-anchored, horizontally centered).
non-modal custom overlay; use showScrim={false} only to hide the backdrop.
title as a Dialog.Title child (title is a Content prop).

Grid.name: Grid

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child (e.g. router Link) instead of <a>. The new-window icon is not added in this mode.
